cases.name: promote_cbc_first_run
cases.notes: inserts one observation per non-rejected test_result; panel cbc from the report name; observed_date = collection_date; the shared alias 'Neutrophils' resolves by unit; the unknown name stays unmapped

cases.name: promote_cbc_second_run
cases.notes: suggested Hb follows its field (7.4, ai_cloud); confirmed platelets -> observation confirmed; TLC field rejected -> observation rejected; the user-edited neutrophil % keeps 63 but follows the corrected collection date; the ANC date set by the user is kept; unmapped Galactomannan unchanged

cases.name: promote_rejection_propagation
cases.notes: rejected fields: suggested and confirmed observations become rejected; user and rejected are kept

cases.name: promote_urine_routine
cases.notes: urine panel from the report name: shared aliases resolve to urine analytes; no dates -> sort_date

cases.name: promote_missing_unit
cases.notes: mapped but no unit -> canonical_value null; a report_date below 0.6 confidence is not a best row

cases.name: observed_date_best_of_two_collection_rows
cases.notes: user row wins regardless of confidence

cases.name: edit_value
cases.notes: flag recomputed from the printed range: 10.5 < 12 -> low

cases.name: edit_unit
cases.notes: range 12-15.5 g/dL converted to 120-155 g/L; 74 g/L -> low; ref_text stays as printed; canonical 7.4 g/dL

cases.name: edit_unit_free_text
cases.notes: free text unit: the printed range cannot be converted -> bounds null, flag unknown, canonical null

cases.name: edit_map_unmapped
cases.notes: analyte_method user

cases.name: edit_remove
cases.notes: remove = rejected

cases.name: edit_qualitative
cases.notes: negative family value and ref -> normal

cases.name: edit_comparator
cases.notes: comparator value is not computable -> unknown

cases.name: edit_range_value
cases.notes: range value 4-6 vs 0-5 -> unknown

cases.name: user_alias_apply_existing
cases.notes: key 'hgb x' updates unmapped, non-rejected observations whose test_name_keys contain it: a (k1) and b (k2 of 'HGB X (Photometric)'); c is rejected, d is already mapped, e has another name

cases.name: edit_unit_not_convertible
cases.notes: mmol/L is not listed for hemoglobin: bounds null, flag unknown (never a wrong low/high)

cases.name: edit_unit_same_unit_spelling
cases.notes: same canonical unit: range and flag unchanged

cases.name: edit_unit_with_new_ref_text
cases.notes: a ref_text in the same patch is taken as typed in the new unit

cases.name: edit_unit_unmapped
cases.notes: no analyte: bounds cannot convert -> null, flag unknown
